title: The Fleet — live architecture
note: The factory's OWN machinery (this repo), not the b2b-api product. fleetd is the single-writer daemon: a UDS control server + a scheduler (the only ledger writer, pacing poll/sync/reconcile) + an OTLP collector, over a SQLite ledger. fleetc is the control surface. reconcile converges intent (orders/convoys/board) against reality (sessions/ships/Jira), spawning & reaping the crew of Claude cogs in tmux. Base edges = the standing topology; pick a flow to light up one dynamic. Positions hand-placed; drag + Copy layout to iterate.

detail.summary: Each reconcile tick (~60s) closes the gap between INTENT (orders · convoys · the board) and REALITY (live sessions · ships · Jira). plan() is pure/read-only and returns a Vec<Action>; execute() applies each one through the ports. A per-action failure is never fatal — the next tick re-derives from the ledger and retries. reconcile owns every Jira transition; no cog moves a ticket itself.

modes.label: Spawn
modes.goal: Turn a queued order into a running implementer.
modes.why: An order exists with no live session whose ticket is Ready (To Do · unheld · blockers terminal) or Stacked (one in-flight blocker with an open ship to fork from).
steps: Read the worktree off the order (a missing worktree aborts the spawn — reconcile never creates one).
Claim gate: tracker.assigned_to_peer? — skip if a peer already owns the ticket (never stomp a peer).
tracker.transition → In Progress, then best-effort assign / label / add-to-sprint.
SessionRepo.start — the one_live_crew_per_ticket DB lock makes a duplicate a benign skip.
host.spawn `claude --session-id <uuid> --agent worker|hand` in the worktree; append SessionStarted.
guarantees: The partial-unique spawn lock kills the double-spawn / zombie-respawn class by construction.

modes.label: Handoff
modes.goal: Hand a concluded build off to the merge sweep.
modes.why: A Worker/Hand self-reports `concluded` (MR open + self-reviewed) and no live sailor exists yet.
steps: tracker.transition → In QA.
forge.request_review — resolve the team from the approval rules, assign reviewers.
End the builder session + kill its tmux pane (SessionEnded).
guarantees: The MR is the memory — a relaunch re-derives from the open ship, never double-hands-off.

modes.label: Sail & Reap
modes.goal: Sweep an open ship toward merge, then reclaim everything when it merges.
modes.why: An open, auto-dispatched ship whose change-fingerprint ≠ last-swept gets a one-shot sailor; a Merged ship with anything left to clean gets reaped.
steps: LaunchSailor — spawn a one-shot sailor in the worktree (fingerprint-gated so it only fires on real change).
The sailor sweeps (rebase / reply / ci-fix / arm) and reports `sleeping`; StandDown ends it so the next change re-fires.
On Merged: tracker.transition → Done + roll-up the parent story, end all sessions, kill tmux, `git worktree remove`, cancel the order.
guarantees: `claude --agent` never self-exits — the sailor's `sleeping` REPORT, not a dead pane, is the finish signal.

modes.label: Heal / StandDown
modes.goal: Recover from a crash without double-acting.
modes.why: A live cog derives Liveness::Dead (tmux gone) while non-terminal and not paused/anchored.
steps: Worker/Hand Dead → Heal: respawn the SAME tmux_session with the SAME --session-id (continuous transcript).
Sailor Dead (one-shot already done) → StandDown: end the session, no respawn.
An anchored_at session is NEVER healed — the anchor is the authoritative hold.
guarantees: Idempotent at restart: re-derives from disk + tmux + ledger, never double-acts.

modes.label: Captain & Lookout
modes.goal: Staff the per-convoy orchestrator and the peer-MR reviewer.
modes.why: One cold captain per active convoy with work; one singleton lookout per changed peer ship.
steps: Active convoy + work + no live captain + not anchored → LaunchCaptain at the hub with FLEET_CONVOY injected.
First peer Open ship whose head_sha ≠ reviewed + no live lookout → LaunchLookout at the hub with FLEET_SHIP=iid (no worktree).
Convoy no longer active / peer gone → StandDownCaptain / StandDownLookout.
guarantees: one_live_captain_per_convoy + one_live_lookout partial indexes enforce the singletons in the DB.

modes.label: Block
modes.goal: Mirror the Jira is-blocked-by graph onto GitLab MR dependencies.
modes.why: A dispatched ticket's blocker has an open ship — the merge gate must reflect the dependency.
steps: For MRs WE dispatched only, resolve the blocker's ship and forge.block_on it (idempotent).
A cycle guard refuses to rewrite a peer's merge gate or form a loop.
guarantees: Only a child we own is blocked — reconcile never rewrites a peer's gate.

detail.type: crates/fleetd/src/scheduler.rs — the pacer + single writer (the daemon's heart)
detail.summary: Owns the ledger and is the authoritative write boundary. One loop with three Instant deadlines fires three tickers on cadences re-read live every iteration (so `fleetc settings set` takes effect without a restart); between ticks it blocks on the command channel with a 500ms quantum. The UDS server is the only sender; the scheduler the only receiver — so every mutation is single-writer, in a transaction, with a CDC event appended in the same txn.

modes.label: poll tick
modes.goal: Keep an accurate in-memory liveness view without a per-query tmux fan-out.
modes.why: Liveness is derived, never stored (apiary's lag-bug lesson — the fan-out runs in ONE place).
steps: Recompute context(): over ledger.live(), probe host.alive + host.last_activity (#{window_activity}) per session.
Classify Liveness { Active · Quiet · Idle · Dead } from age-of-activity vs thresholds.
Overwrite the snapshot mutex that GET /context reads lock-free; a class change emits an event.
guarantees: No DB writes — a restart just re-polls; the snapshot is memoized, never trusted stale.

modes.label: sync tick
modes.goal: Hydrate the ledger from the two external realities.
modes.why: board (Jira) + armada (GitLab) replace the old jira.json / mrs.json caches.
steps: sync_board (tracker) BEFORE sync_armada (forge) — so ships can link their ticket FK.
Upsert tickets + ticket_blocks + ships; enrich only OUR ships with the per-MR snapshot.
Append a TickRan event carrying before/after change-counts (no-op detection).
guarantees: Factory-owned facts (held · created_at) survive a tracker re-sync; only the cache churns.

modes.label: reconcile tick
modes.goal: Converge intent against reality (see the reconcile node).
modes.why: Reads dry_run live; clones the poll's cog snapshot (no extra tmux fan-out).
steps: Call reconcile::tick with the cloned cogs.
dry_run=true → log the planned Action[] as a TickRan event (the parity lens).
dry_run=false → execute() per action, recording applied / failed.
guarantees: A per-action failure never aborts the tick — the next cycle retries.

modes.label: apply (writes)
modes.goal: Serialize every client write through one transactional path.
modes.why: 15 Command variants (status · dispatch · convoy · anchor/weigh/sink · send · hold · rebase · settings).
steps: Receive a Command from the UDS server over the mpsc channel.
Apply it in a transaction, appending the matching CDC event in the same txn.
Control verbs push a graceful-stop / resume / kill through SessionHost::send; sink also kills tmux.
guarantees: Single writer, in transactions → no last-writer-wins races; the event log can't lie about state.

nodes.label: ledger.db
nodes.sub: tickets · orders · sessions · ships · convoys · events

flows.label: Dispatch → worker spawned
flows.note: fleetc dispatch writes an order; the next reconcile tick claims the ticket in Jira and spawns a worker in the pre-berthed worktree. Grounded @ 1cdee16.

flows.label: Worker builds → handoff to sailor
flows.note: The worker opens the MR and self-reports `concluded`; reconcile transitions the ticket to In QA, requests review, and reaps the builder pane. Grounded @ 1cdee16.

flows.label: Sailor sweeps → ship merged → reaped
flows.note: A fingerprint-gated sailor does ONE sweep per ship change, reports `sleeping`, and re-fires on the next change until GitLab merges; then reconcile reaps everything. Grounded @ 1cdee16.
resources: ships / ship_snapshots — synced (armed · merge_status, never stored-trusted)

flows.label: Sync tick — hydrate the ledger
flows.note: Every ~300s the scheduler pulls the board (Jira) and armada (GitLab) into the ledger — board before armada so ships can link their ticket FK. Replaces jira.json / mrs.json. Grounded @ 1cdee16.
resources: ships + ship_snapshots — the armada mirror (ours enriched)

flows.label: Convoy opened → captain staffed
flows.note: The admiral grooms + opens a convoy; reconcile staffs one cold captain per active convoy, which reads its slice and dispatches the frontier. The admiral opens; reconcile launches. Grounded @ 1cdee16.

steps.label: groom to Definition of Ready (blocked-by edges)

flows.label: Peer-MR review (parallel, off the line)
flows.note: The singleton lookout reviews one PEER MR (never our own ships) per changed head, from the hub by SHA — no checkout. fleetd records the reviewed head and re-fires on the next change. Grounded @ 1cdee16.
resources: ships.reviewed — the head_sha last reviewed (re-fire detector)
our ships never pass here — peers only (team review owns ours)

flows.label: Anchor / weigh / sink a cog
flows.note: anchor is a graceful stop-and-hold stamped on the session; heal never respawns an anchored cog. weigh clears it; sink is the separate destructive teardown. Grounded @ 1cdee16.
resources: sessions.anchored_at — the authoritative hold (heal skips it)
sink = end session + kill tmux (destructive — a deliberate separate verb)

flows.label: Telemetry & cost
flows.note: Every cog emits OTLP logs to the built-in collector, written to a SEPARATE telemetry.db (off the single-writer ledger path, since it's append-heavy). fleetc cost reads it read-only. Grounded @ 1cdee16.
resources: telemetry.db — append-only, isolated from the ledger
cost_by_role — interactive (NULL role) vs per-cog spend
